Script: app.open("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe Illustrator 2026/Presets/en_US/Brushes/Bristle Brush/Bristle Brush Library.ai"), doc.brushes.getByName("Touch Calligraphic Brush").applyTo(pathItem) on a path in that document, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the brush arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Heavy even-width solid black stroke with rounded ends, the same as the Borders_Novelty copy.

cards.name: Banner 1
cards.summary: Art brush: one white ribbon banner stretched along the whole path, a white band with a red outline and folded-back ends at both tips that show a light grey underside and forked swallowtail notches. Classic label-ribbon look. Rendered on a dark grey backdrop because the artwork is white / light. (Thumbnail: the brush applied by script to a 300 pt S-curve with a 1 pt stroke in its library document, not a shipped preview.)
use_for: headline or title ribbon on a gentle arc
avoid: S-curves and tight bends: the whole ribbon twists and the tails distort; use a gentle arc or straight path
holding text by itself: set type on a separate path over it
white backgrounds: the white body disappears and only the red outline shows

cards.name: Banner 10
cards.summary: Art brush: a single long pale-peach band with no outline stretched along the path, one end clipped with angled corners and marked by a small dark eyelet ringed in pink with two thin dark strings trailing from it, the other end cut at an angle. It reads more like a stretched paper tag on a string than a ribbon banner; the picture differs from the name. Rendered on a dark grey backdrop because the artwork is white / light. (Thumbnail: the brush applied by script to a 300 pt S-curve with a 1 pt stroke in its library document, not a shipped preview.)
use_for: gift-tag or price-tag style label strip
soft pastel title band on a gentle arc
avoid: a classic folded ribbon banner: use Banner 1
S-curves and tight bends: the band twists and the eyelet end distorts
light backgrounds: the pale peach band has no outline and fades
